Rumizi has three plans, billed per venue in USD. New venues start on a
30-day Pro trial — no card required to begin.

## The plans

<Columns cols={3}>
  <Card title="Free" icon="gift">
    **$0**, always. One menu with up to 5 categories and 50 items. Manual
    editing only — AI features are Pro-and-up.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Pro" icon="sparkles">
    **$99 / month** or **$990 / year**. Unlimited menus and items, AI menu
    upload, the vendor and diner assistants, and AI image generation.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Max" icon="rocket">
    **$249 / month** or **$2,490 / year**. Everything in Pro plus a higher
    monthly AI usage allowance for high-volume venues.
  </Card>
</Columns>

<Note>
Yearly on Pro and Max is priced below paying month-by-month for a full
year. Menu prices are independent — your menu can be priced in any
currency; only the subscription itself is USD.
</Note>

## Subscribe

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Billing">
    In the workspace, go to **Billing**. Direct URL:
    `rumizi.com/your-venue/w/billing`.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pick a plan and cadence">
    Tap **Pro** or **Max**, then choose **Monthly** or **Yearly**. You're
    redirected to Stripe's secure checkout page.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pay">
    Fill in your card details on Stripe. Rumizi never sees your card
    number.
  </Step>
  <Step title="You're active">
    After a successful payment, Stripe sends a confirmation back to
    Rumizi and your venue is marked active. You can go back to your
    workspace.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## The 30-day Pro trial

New venues start on a **30-day trial of Pro**. Full AI features,
unlimited menus and items, and a live public menu — no credit card
required to begin.

When the trial ends, your venue automatically moves to the **Free**
plan unless you subscribe to Pro or Max. Free is a real plan, not a
lockout — your public menu stays live within Free's one-menu, 5-category,
50-item limits.

<Note>
Billing status is authoritative in your workspace. Trials, coupons, or
special terms can change what applies to you — the Billing page after
sign-in always shows your current price and status.
</Note>

## 100% satisfaction

If Rumizi doesn't work for you in the first month, email
[hi@rumizi.com](mailto:hi@rumizi.com) and I'll sort it out personally.

## What's not in v1

A few billing features aren't in this version yet:

- **In-app cancel** — to cancel, email
  [hi@rumizi.com](mailto:hi@rumizi.com) and I'll cancel for you.
- **Change card in-app** — same: email me.
- **Multi-currency billing** — subscriptions are USD only. Menu prices
  are independent — your menu can be priced in any currency.
